messages:
anya: FYI spun up quokka-embed-v2 (int6 per-channel) on staging and ran a quick anchor holdout smoke.
sam: ok good call. quick summary? :eyes:
diego: any change to tokenization or preproc compared to opal-embed-v1?
anya: no tokenization changes. only quant pipeline: per-channel int6 with a tiny fp16 fallback for very long sequences.
eval-bot: smoke results (10k holdout): baseline opal-v1 -> R@1=0.482 R@5=0.712 R@10=0.805; quokka-int6 -> R@1=0.447 R@5=0.695 R@10=0.767. drop concentrated on short queries.
mira: ouch, ~3.8% abs at R@10. did you check cluster metrics?
anya: ran kmeans(50) on embeddings then silhouette_score -> baseline 0.213, quokka-int6 0.143. attached snippet for how I computed it.
sam: is degradation uniform? short vs long?
anya: split by query length: short (<8 tokens) R@10 delta -0.06, medium -0.02, long ~0.0. looks like short queries are losing specificity.
diego: sounds like quant noise in early projection dims. can you dump pairwise diffs and a few exemplar failures?
anya: doing that now. ops-bot: deployed quokka-int6 to staging pool-bridge-2 (4 GPUs), version 2026-03-20-12:01.
eval-bot: diagnostic on 200 failing short queries: median cosine drop 0.012, mean embedding norm -6%, top-1 flips often to broader synonyms rather than exact matches.
mira: norm reduction suggests a scale bias after quant. options: per-dim rescale post-quant, re-introduce a small layernorm, or a short-query calibration transform.
sam: propose two experiments: (A) learn per-channel affine rescale on 5k short-query calibration set; (B) keep int6 but enable fp16 fallback for first self-attn kv and re-eval.
diego: also include a tiny recalibration pass where you run a linear least-squares fit from quantized->float outputs on calibration set, test generalization to holdout.
anya: launching A and B now, will run recall + silhouette + a short exemplar dump. ETA ~2hrs.
anya: example where baseline had exact match and quokka returned looser synonym: 
- query: "how to reset password"
- baseline top1: "reset password steps"
- quokka top1: "account recovery options"
(more examples coming)
sam: thanks. if rescale works we can try adding it as a tiny post-quant hook in the serving runtime so Dedicated/private customers get consistent behavior.
mira: also add an eval that computes top-k label precision on the short-query cohort specifically; easier to track improvements.
anya: will add that metric. pinging when runs finish. :coffee:
